verdict.rationale: stagewise automatically generates a persistent WORKSPACE.md file in .stagewise/ when a workspace is connected, and the agent uses it as its primary high-level understanding of the project. That is a product-owned, automatically built form of project memory stored on disk. However, nothing shows the agent updating this memory from session interactions or recalling learned facts across chat sessions. SKILL.md files are user-authored instructions, not automatic memory, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: evidence that memory is built from agent sessions, documented updates or refresh of WORKSPACE.md over time, explicit cross-session recall behavior, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions

citations.quote: When you connect a workspace, stagewise generates a WORKSPACE.md file in .stagewise/. This is the primary way the agent understands your project at a high level
